summary.oneLiner: Pan-India provider of manpower services (manned security, IFM, sourcing/payroll), toll plaza management and skill development training, operating across 23 states and 5 union territories.
summary.business: Innovision provides manpower services (manned private security, integrated facility management, and manpower sourcing/payroll), toll plaza user-fee collection management, and government-scheme skill development training. It began with manned private security in 2007, added skill development in Fiscal 2014 and toll plaza management in Fiscal 2019. Through subsidiaries it also offers recruitment/visa facilitation (Innovision International) and remote-pilot drone training (Aerodrone Robotics).

currentContext.business: Innovision provides manpower services (manned private security, integrated facility management, and manpower sourcing/payroll), toll plaza user-fee collection management, and government-scheme skill development training. It began with manned private security in 2007, added skill development in Fiscal 2014 and toll plaza management in Fiscal 2019. Through subsidiaries it also offers recruitment/visa facilitation (Innovision International) and remote-pilot drone training (Aerodrone Robotics).

Manpower Services: Integrated Facility Management (Hard FM / Soft FM)
Toll Plaza Management: User-fee collection and related services on national-highway toll plazas (NHAI empanelled)
Skill Development Training: Government-scheme vocational training across sectors (healthcare, BFSI, retail, logistics, etc.)
Subsidiary services: Recruitment, placement consultancy and visa facilitation (Innovision International)

currentContext.expansion: Growth is service/contract-led rather than plant-led: expansion of manpower client base (180+ clients, 1,000+ premises), additional toll plaza tenders with NHAI/authorities, and new verticals in drone training and international recruitment/visa services.
